@Override
    public String toString() {
      return "TestApp{"
          + "submissionId='"
          + submissionId
          + '\''
          + ", submitTime="
          + submitTime
          + ", submitLatencyMillis="
          + submitLatency
          + ", state='"
          + state
          + '\''
          + ", completedTime="
          + completedTime
          + ", driverStartLatencySeconds="
          + getDriverStartLatencySeconds()
          + ", applicationFinishLatency="
          + getApplicationFinishLatency()
          + '}';
    }
